jeevavaakyamunugoorchinadhi, aadhinundi edi yundeno, memedi vintimo, kannulaara edi chuchithimo, edi nidaaninchi kanugontimo, maa chethulu dhenini thaaki chucheno, adhi meeku teliyajeyuchunnaamu.
aa jeevamu pratyakshamaayenu; thandriyoddha undi maaku pratyakshamaina aa nityajeevamunu memu chuchi, aa jeeva munugoorchi saakshyamichuchu, daanini meeku teliya parachuchunnaamu.

maathookooda meekunu sahavaasamu kalugunatlu memu chuchinadaanini vininadaanini meekunu teliyajeyuchunnaamu. Mana sahavaasamaithe thandrithoo koodanu aayana kumaarudaina yesukreesthu thookoodanu unnadhi.
mana santhooshamu paripoornamavutakai memee sangathulanu vraayuchunnaamu.
memaayanavalana vini meeku prakatinchu varthamaana memanagaa dhevudu velugai yunnaadu; aayanayandu chikati enthamaatramunu ledu.
aayanathookooda sahavaasamugalavaaramani cheppukoni chikatilo nadichinayedala manamabaddhamaaduchu satyamunu jarigimpakundumu.

ayithe aayana velugulonunna prakaaramu manamunu velugulo nadichinayedala. Manamu anyonyasahavaasamu galavaaramai yundumu; appudu aayana kumaarudaina yesu rakthamu prathi paapamunundi manalanu pavitrulanugaa cheyunu.
manamu paapamulenivaaramani cheppukonina yedala, manalanu maname mosapuchukondumu; mariyu manalo satya mundadu.
mana paapamulanu manamu oppukonina yedala, aayana nammadaginavaadunu neethimanthudunu ganuka aayana mana paapamulanu kshaminchi samastha durneethinundi manalanu pavitrulanugaa cheyunu.
manamu paapamu cheyaledani cheppukoninayedala, aayananu abaddhikunigaa cheyuvaara magudumu; mariyu aayana vaakyamu manalo undadu.

naa chinnapillalaaraa, meeru paapamu cheyakundutakai yee sangathulanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu. Evadainanu paapamu chesinayedala neethimanthudaina yesukreesthu anu uttharavaadhi thandriyoddha manakunnaadu.
aayane mana paapamulaku shaanthikaramai yunnaadu; mana paapamulaku maatramekaadu. Sarvalokamunakunu shaanthikaramai yunnaadu.
mariyu manamaayana aagnalanu gaikonina yedala, deenivalanane aayananu erigiyunnaamani telisi kondumu.
aayananu erigiyunnaanani cheppukonuchu, aayana aagnalanu gaikonanivaadu abaddhikudu; vaanilo satyamuledu.
aayana vaakyamu evadu gaikonuno vaanilo dhevuni prema nijamugaa paripoornamaayenu;
aayanayandu nilichiyunnavaadanani cheppukonuvaadu aayana elaagu naduchukoneno aalaage thaanunu naduchukona baddhudaiyunnaadu. Manamaayanayandunnaamani deenivalana telisikonuchunnaamu.
priyulaaraa, modatanundi meekunna poorvapu aagnanegaani krottha aagnanu nenu meeku vraayutaledu; ee poorvapu aagna meeru vinina vaakyame.
mariyu krottha aagnanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu. chikati gathinchu chunnadhi, satyamaina velugu ippudu prakaashinchuchunnadhi ganuka adhi aayanayandunu meeyandunu satyame.
velugulo unnaanani cheppukonuchu, thana sahodaruni dveshinchuvaadu ippativarakunu chikatilone yunnaadu.
thana sahodaruni preminchuvaadu velugulo unnavaadu; athaniyandu abhyantharakaaranamediyu ledu.
thana sahodaruni dveshinchuvaadu chikatilo undi, chikatilo naduchuchunnaadu; chikati athani kannulaku gruddithanamu kalugajesenu ganuka thaanekkadiki povuchunnaado athaniki teliyadu.
chinna pillalaaraa, aayana naamamubatti mee paapamulu kshamimpabadinavi ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
thandrulaaraa, meeru aadhinundi yunnavaanini erigi yunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu. ¸Yauvanasthu laaraa, meeru dushtuni jayinchiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.

chinna pillalaaraa, meeru thandrini erigiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu. thandrulaaraa, meeru aadhinundi yunnavaanini erigi yunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.Yauvanasthulaaraa, meeru balavanthulu, dhevunivaakyamu meeyandu niluchuchunnadhi; meeru dushtuni jayinchiyunnaaru ganuka meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
ee lokamunainanu lokamulo unnavaatinainanu premimpakudi. Evadainanu lokamunu preminchinayedala thandri prema vaanilo nundadu.
lokamulo unnadanthayu, anagaa shareeraashayu netraashayu jeevapudambamunu thandrivalana puttinavi kaavu; avi lokasambandhamainave.
lokamunu daani aashayu gathinchipovuchunnavi gaani, dhevuni chitthamunu jariginchuvaadu nirantharamunu niluchunu.
chinna pillalaaraa, yidi kadavari gadiya. Kreesthu virodhi vachunani vintiri gadaa ippudunu anekulaina kreesthu virodhulu bayaludheriyunnaaru; idi kadavari gadiya ani deenichetha telisikonuchunnaamu.

vaaru manalonundi bayaluvelliri gaani vaaru mana sambandhulu kaaru; vaaru mana sambandhulaithe manathoo kooda nilichiyunduru; ayithe vaarandaru mana sambandhulu kaarani pratyaksha parachabadunatlu vaaru bayaluvelliri.
ayithe meeru parishuddhunivalana abhishekamu pondinavaaru ganuka samasthamunu eruguduru.
meeru satyameruganivaarainanduna nenu vraayaledu gaani, meeru daanini erigiyunnandunanu, e abaddhamunu satyasambandhamainadhi kaadani yerigi yunnandunanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
yesu, kreesthu kaadani cheppuvaadu thappa evadabaddhikudu? thandrini kumaaruni oppukonani veede kreesthuvirodhi.
kumaaruni oppukonani prathivaadunu thandrini angeekarinchuvaadukaadu; kumaaruni oppukonuvaadu thandrini angeekarinchu vaadu.
ayithe meeru modatanundi dhenini vintiro adhi meelo niluvaniyyudi; meeru modatanundi vininadhi meelo nilichinayedala, meerukooda kumaaruniyandunu thandriyandunu niluthuru.
nityajeevamu anugrahinthu nanunadhiye aayana thaane manaku chesina vaagdaanamu,
mimmunu mosaparachuvaarinibatti yee sangathulu meeku vraasiyunnaanu.

ayithe aayanavalana meeru pondina abhishekamu meelo niluchuchunnadhi ganuka evadunu meeku bodhimpanakkaraledu; aayana ichina abhishekamu satyame gaani abaddhamu kaadu; adhi annitinigoorchi meeku bodhinchuchunna prakaaramugaanu, aayana meeku bodhinchina prakaaramugaanu, aayanalo meeru niluchuchunnaaru
kaabatti chinna pillalaaraa, aayana pratyakshamagunappudu aayana raakadayandu manamu aayana yeduta siggupadaka dhairyamu kaligiyundunatlu meeraayana yandu nilichiyundudi.
aayana neethimanthudani meererigi yunna yedala neethini jariginchu prathivaadunu aayana moolamugaa puttiyunnaadani yeruguduru.
manamu dhevuni pillalamani piluvabadunatlu thandri manaketti prema nanugrahincheno choodudi; manamu dhevuni pillalame.ee hethuvuchetha lokamu manalanu erugadu, yelayanagaa adhi aayananu erugaledu.

priyulaaraa, yippudu manamu dhevuni pillalamai yunnaamu. Manamika emavudumo adhi inka pratyakshaparachabadaledu gaani aayana pratyakshamainappudu aayana yunnatlugaane aayananu choothumu ganuka aayananu poliyundumani yerugudumu.
aayanayandu ee nireekshana pettukonina prathivaadunu aayana pavitrudai yunnattugaa thannu pavitrunigaa chesikonunu.
paapamu cheyu prathivaadunu aagnanu athikraminchunu; aagnaathikramame paapamu.
paapamulanu theesiveyutakai aayana pratyakshamaayenani meeku teliyunu; aayanayandu paapamemiyu ledu.
aayanayandu nilichiyunduvaadevadunu paapamu cheyadu; paapamu cheyuvaadevadunu aayananu choodanuledu eruganuledu.
chinna pillalaaraa, yevanini mimmunu mosaparachaneeyakudi. aayana neethimanthudaiyunnattu neethini jariginchu prathivaadunu neethimanthudu.
apavaadhi modata nundi paapamu cheyuchunnaadu ganuka paapamu cheyuvaadu apavaadhi sambandhi; apavaadhi yokka kriyalanu layaparachutake dhevuni kumaarudu pratyakshamaayenu.
dhevuni moolamugaa puttina prathivaanilo aayana beejamu niluchunu ganuka vaadu paapamucheyadu; vaadu dhevuni moolamugaa puttinavaadu ganuka paapamu cheyajaaladu.
deeninibatti dhevuni pillalevaro apavaadhi pillalevaro thetapadunu. neethini jariginchani prathivaadunu, thana sahodaruni premimpani prathivaadunu dhevuni sambandhulu kaaru.
manamokani nokadu premimpavalenanunadhi modatanundi meeru vinina varthamaanamegadaa

manamu kayeenu vantivaaramai yundaraadu. Vaadu dushtuni sambandhiyai thana sahodaruni champenu; vaadathanini enduku champenu? thana kriyalu cheddaviyu thana sahodaruni kriyalu neethi galaviyunai yundenu ganukane gadaa?
sahodarulaaraa, lokamu mimmunu dveshinchina yedala aashcharyapadakudi.
manamu sahodarulanu preminchuchunnaamu ganuka maranamulonundi jeevamuloniki daatiyunnaamani yerugudumu. Prema leni vaadu maranamandu nilichiyunnaadu.
thana sahodaruni dveshinchuvaadu narahanthakudu; e narahanthakuniyandunu nityajeevamundadani meereruguduru.
aayana mana nimitthamu thana praanamupettenu ganuka deenivalana prema yettidani telisikonuchunnaamu. Manamukooda sahodarulanimitthamu mana praanamulanu petta baddhulamai yunnaamu.
ee lokapu jeevanopaadhigalavaadaiyundi, thana sahodaruniki lemi kaluguta chuchiyu, athaniyedala enthamaatramunu kanikaramu choopanivaaniyandu dhevuni prema yelaagu niluchunu?
chinna pillalaaraa, maatathoonu naalukathoonu kaaka kriyathoonu satyamuthoonu preminthamu.

indu valana manamu satyasambandhulamani yerugudumu. dhevudu mana hrudayamukante adhikudai, samasthamunu erigi yunnaadu ganuka mana hrudayamu e ye vishayamulalo manayandu doshaaropana cheyuno aa yaa vishayamulalo aayana yeduta mana hrudayamulanu sammathi parachukondamu.
priyulaaraa, mana hrudayamu mana yandu doshaaropana cheyaniyedala dhevuni yeduta dhairyamugalavaaramagudumu.
mariyu manamaayana aagnalanu gaikonuchu aayana drushtiki ishtamainavi cheyu chunnaamu ganuka, manamemi adiginanu adhi aayanavalana manaku dorukunu.
aayana aagna yedhanagaa aayana kumaarudaina yesukreesthu naamamunu nammukoni, aayana manaku aagnanichina prakaaramugaa okaninokadu premimpa valenanunadhiye.
aayana aagnalanu gaikonuvaadu aayana yandu nilichiyundunu, aayana vaaniyandu nilichi yundunu; aayana manayandu nilichiyunnaadani
aayana manakanugrahinchina aatmamoolamugaa telisikonu chunnaamu.
priyulaaraa, anekulaina abaddha pravakthalu lokamu loniki bayalu velliyunnaaru ganuka prathi aatmanu nammaka, aa yaa aatmalu dhevuni sambandhamainavo kaavo pareekshinchudi.
yesukreesthu shareeradhaariyai vacchenani, ye aatma oppukonuno adhi dhevuni sambandhamainadhi;

ye aatma yesunu oppukonado adhi dhevuni sambandhamainadhi kaadu; deeninibattiye dhevuni aatmanu meereruguduru. Kreesthuvirodhi aatma vachunani meeru vininasangathi idhe; yidivarake adhi lokamulo unnadhi.
chinnapillalaaraa, meeru dhevuni sambandhulu; meelo unnavaadu lokamulo unnavaani kante goppavaadu ganuka meeru vaarini jayinchiyunnaaru.
vaaru loka sambandhulu ganuka loka sambandhulainattu maatalaaduduru, lokamu vaari maata vinunu.

manamu dhevuni sambandhulamu; dhevuni eriginavaadu mana maata vinunu, dhevuni sambandhi kaanivaadu mana maata vinadu. Induvalana manamu satya svaroopa maina aatma yedo, bhramaparachu aatma yedo telisikonu chunnaamu.
priyulaaraa, manamu okaninokadu preminthamu; yelayanagaa prema dhevunimoolamugaa kaluguchunnadhi; preminchu prathivaadunu dhevuni moolamugaa puttinavaadai dhevuni erugunu.
dhevudu premaasvaroopi, premaleni vaadu dhevuni erugadu.
manamu aayana dvaaraa jeevinchu natlu, dhevudu thana advitheeya kumaaruni lokamuloniki pampenu; deenivalana dhevudu manayandunchina prema pratyakshaparachabadenu.
manamu dhevuni preminchithimani kaadu, thaane manalanu preminchi, mana paapamulaku praayashchitthamai yundutaku thana kumaaruni pampenu; indulo premayunnadhi.
priyulaaraa, dhevudu manalanu eelaagu premimpagaa manamokaninokadu premimpa baddhulamai yunnaamu.
e maanavudunu dhevuni eppudunu chuchiyunda ledu; mana mokaninokadu preminchina yedala dhevudu manayandu nilichiyundunu; aayana prema manayandu sampoornamagunu.
deenivalana manamu aayanayandu nilichiyunnaamaniyu aayana mana yandunnaadaniyu telisikonuchunnaamu; yelayanagaa aayana manaku thana aatmalo paalu dayachesiyunnaadu.
mariyu thandri thana kumaaruni loka rakshakudugaa undutaku pampiyunduta memu chuchi, saakshyamichu chunnaamu.
yesu dhevuni kumaarudani yevadu oppu konuno, vaanilo dhevudu nilichiyunnaadu, vaadu dhevuniyandunnaadu.

manayedala dhevuniki unna premanu manameriginavaaramai daani nammukoniyunnaamu; dhevudu premaasvaroopiyai yunnaadu, premayandu nilichi yunduvaadu dhevuniyandu nilichiyunnaadu, dhevudu vaaniyandu nilichiyunnaadu.
theerpudinamandu manaku dhairyamu kalugunatlu deenivalana prema manalo paripoornamu cheyabadi yunnadhi; yelayanagaa aayana ettivaadai yunnaado manamukooda ee lokamulo attivaaramai yunnaamu.
premalo bhayamundadu; anthekaadu; paripoorna prema bhayamunu vellagottunu; bhayamu dandanathoo koodinadhi; bhayapaduvaadu premayandu paripoornamu cheyabadinavaadu kaadu.
aayane modata manalanu preminchenu ganuka manamu preminchuchunnaamu.

evadainanu nenu dhevuni preminchuchunnaanani cheppi, thana sahodaruni dveshinchinayedala athadu abaddhikudagunu; thaanu chuchina thana sahodaruni premimpani vaadu thaanu choodani dhevuni premimpaledu.
dhevuni preminchuvaadu thana sahodaruni kooda premimpavale nanu aagnanu manamaayanavalana pondiyunnaamu.
yese kreesthayi yunnaadani nammu prathivaadunu dhevunimoolamugaa puttiyunnaadu. Puttinchinavaanini preminchu prathivaadunu aayana moolamugaa puttina vaanini preminchunu.
manamu dhevuni preminchuchu aayana aagnalanu neraverchuvaaramaithimaa dhevuni pillalanu preminchuchunnaamani daanivalanane yerugudumu.
manamaayana aagnalanu gaikonutaye. dhevuni preminchuta; aayana aagnalu bhaaramainavi kaavu.
dhevuni moolamugaa puttinavaarandarunu lokamunu jayinchuduru; lokamunu jayinchina vijayamu mana vishvaasame
yesu dhevuni kumaarudani nammu vaadu thappa lokamunu jayinchuvaadu mari evadu?
neelladvaaraanu rakthamudvaaraanu vachina vaadu eeyane, anagaa yesukreesthe. eeyana neellathoo maatramegaaka neellathoonu rakthamuthoonu vacchenu. aatma satyamu ganuka saakshyamichuvaadu aatmaye.
saakshya michuvaaru mugguru, anagaa aatmayu, neellunu,rakthamunu, ee mugguru ekeebhavinchi yunnaaru.
manamu manushyula saakshyamu angeekarinchuchunnaamu gadaa! dhevuni saakshyamu mari balamainadhi. dhevuni saakshyamu aayana thana kumaaruni goorchi yichinadhe.

dhevuni kumaaruniyandu vishvaasa munchuvaadu thanalone yee saakshyamu kaligiyunnaadu; dhevuni nammanivaadu aayana thana kumaarunigoorchi yichina saakshyamunu nammaledu ganuka athadu dhevuni abaddhikunigaa chesinavaade.
aa saakshyamemanagaa dhevudu manaku nitya jeevamunu dayachesenu; ee jeevamu aayana kumaaruni yandunnadhi.
dhevuni kumaaruni angeekarinchuvaadu jeevamu galavaadu; dhevuni kumaaruni angeekarimpani vaadu jeevamuleni vaade.
dhevuni kumaaruni naamamandu vishvaasamunchu meeru nityajeevamugalavaarani telisikonunatlu nenu ee sangathulanu meeku vraayuchunnaanu.
aayananubatti manaku kaligina dhairyamedhanagaa, aayana chitthaanusaaramugaa mana medi adiginanu aayana mana manavi aalakinchunanunadhiye.
manamemi adiginanu aayana mana manavi aalankinchunani mana meriginayedala manamaayananu vedukoninavi manaku kaliginavani yerugudumu.

thana sahodarudu maranakaramu kaani paapamu cheyagaa evadainanu chuchinayedala athadu vedu konunu; athanibatti dhevudu maranakaramukaani paapamu chesinavaariki jeevamu dayacheyunu. Maranakaramaina paapamu kaladu. Attidaanigoorchi vedukonavalenani nenu chepputaledu.
sakala durneethiyu paapamu; ayithe maranakaramu kaani paapamu kaladu.
dhevuni moolamugaa puttiyunna vaadevadunu paapamu cheyadani yerugudumu. dhevunimoolamugaa puttinavaadu thannu bhadramuchesikonunu ganuka dushtudu vaani muttadu.
manamu dhevuni sambandhulamaniyu,lokamanthayu dushtuni yandunnadaniyu erugudumu.
manamu satyavanthudaina vaanini erugavalenani dhevuni kumaarudu vachimanaku viveka manugrahinchiyunnaadani yerugudumu.
manamu dhevuni kumaarudaina yesukreesthunandunna vaaramai satya vanthuni yandunnaamu. aayane nijamaina dhevudunu nityajeevamunai yunnaadu.
chinna pillalaaraa, vigrahamula joliki pokunda jaagratthagaa undudi.
